claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact source-pinned BR12.0 semantic body-region contact-role registry and labeled-box basis-oracle scope; BR12.1 deterministic profile-specific canonical-pose classifier scope; BR12.2 semantic anatomy-role recovery-profile matching scope; and BR12.3 conservative static torque, power, structural, friction, and reach feasibility scope. BR12.4 is integrity-only containment and cannot substitute for a milestone program. The BR12 claim boundary is verbatim: BR12 is observer/planner truth only. It classifies only declared labeled-box canonical poses, preserves ambiguous or invalid evidence as unknown, names missing anatomy, and reports whether one exact profile passes preregistered static inequalities before actuation. A feasible report is not dynamic execution evidence. No BR12 program contains a recovery controller, emits an actuator command, wrench, or joint target, creates or maintains contact, applies external assistance, raises a body, hands off to stance, repairs a creature, or guides one automatically. It establishes no physical self-righting or getting up, free-3D standing or bracing, generalized recovery, gait, or walking.

programs.claim_scope: The strict semantic registry seals the declared body-region contact roles, distinguishes steady stance from temporary recovery support, rejects duplicate identities, invalid support policy, and guidance authority, while the labeled-box oracle fixes the authored +X right, +Y up, -Z forward basis, preserves orthonormal handedness, and fails closed on invalid or nonfinite basis evidence.

The deterministic profile-specific classifier combines declared labeled-box orientation and required semantic support contact to classify only upright, prone, supine, left-side, and right-side canonical poses; returns unknown for ambiguous, conflicting, incomplete, invalid, or nonfinite evidence; and grants no actuation, repair, or guidance authority.

The strict recovery profile references anatomy through semantic roles rather than limb indices, binds one exact prone static-feasibility sequence, names every missing required role, rejects duplicates and unknown roles, and exposes no controller, command, contact-creation, repair, or guidance channel.

The digest-bound analyzer evaluates conservative static torque, power, structural, friction, and reach margins for one exact semantic-role recovery profile; names underpowered, overloaded, slipping, unreachable, and anatomically incomplete phases before actuation; and treats feasible as a planning-screen result rather than dynamic recovery evidence.

Integrity-only containment preserves the verbatim observer/planner boundary and proves that a hidden controller, get-up claim, contact creation, external assistance, automatic application, guidance, unknown-pose guessing, missing-anatomy feasibility, or command, wrench, and joint-target output channels fail closed; it cannot substitute for a milestone cell or physical recovery evidence.
